cards.name: Hoppip
cards.description: This Pokémon is blown across vast distances by the wind. It is unclear where the Hoppip of Paldea originally came from.

cards.name: Skiploom
cards.description: Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the flower on the Pokémon's head.

cards.name: Jumpluff
cards.description: Jumpluff travels on seasonal winds. Once its cotton spores run out, its journey ends, as does its life.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.description: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.description: It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.description: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

cards.name: Combee
cards.description: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

cards.name: Vespiquen
cards.description: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

cards.name: Snover
cards.description: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

cards.name: Abomasnow
cards.description: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

cards.name: Sprigatito
cards.description: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

cards.name: Sprigatito
cards.description: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

cards.name: Floragato
cards.description: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

cards.name: Tarountula
cards.description: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

cards.name: Tarountula
cards.description: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

cards.name: Spidops
cards.description: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

cards.name: Nymble
cards.description: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

cards.name: Nymble
cards.description: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

cards.name: Lokix
cards.description: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

cards.name: Bramblin
cards.description: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

cards.name: Bramblin
cards.description: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

cards.name: Brambleghast
cards.description: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

cards.name: Rellor
cards.description: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

cards.name: Rellor
cards.description: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

cards.name: Paldean Tauros
cards.description: People call this kind of Tauros the Blaze Breed due to the hot air it snorts from its nostrils. Its three tails are intertwined.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.description: Fletchinder scatters embers in tall grass where bug Pokémon might be hiding and then catches them as they come leaping out.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.description: It has top-notch flying capabilities. It flies around easily, even while carrying prey that weighs more than 220 lbs.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.description: When Litleo are young, female Pyroar will teach them how to hunt. Once the Litleo mature, they will leave the pride and set out on their own.

cards.name: Pyroar
cards.description: The females of a pride work together to bring down prey. It's thanks to them that their pride doesn't starve.

cards.name: Oricorio
cards.description: This Pokémon is incredibly popular, possibly because its passionate dancing is a great match with the temperament of Paldean people.

cards.name: Fuecoco
cards.description: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

cards.name: Fuecoco
cards.description: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

cards.name: Crocalor
cards.description: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Paldean Tauros
cards.description: It swims by jetting water from its horns. The most notable characteristic of the Aqua Breed is its high body fat, which allows it to float easily.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.description: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

cards.name: Marill
cards.description: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.description: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.description: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by the food it had.

cards.name: Luvdisc
cards.description: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a Luvdisc to someone you love.

cards.name: Eiscue
cards.description: On hot days, these Pokémon press their ice cube heads together and pass the time cooling each other down.

cards.name: Quaxly
cards.description: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

cards.name: Quaxly
cards.description: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

cards.name: Quaxwell
cards.description: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

cards.name: Cetoddle
cards.description: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

cards.name: Cetoddle
cards.description: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

cards.name: Cetitan
cards.description: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.

cards.name: Veluza
cards.description: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

cards.name: Frigibax
cards.description: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

cards.name: Frigibax
cards.description: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

cards.name: Arctibax
cards.description: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

cards.name: Baxcalibur
cards.description: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.description: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.

cards.name: Pincurchin
cards.description: This Pokémon generates electricity when it digests food. It uses its five hard teeth to scrape seaweed off surfaces and eat it.

cards.name: Pincurchin
cards.description: This Pokémon generates electricity when it digests food. It uses its five hard teeth to scrape seaweed off surfaces and eat it.

cards.name: Pawmi
cards.description: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

cards.name: Pawmo
cards.description: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

cards.name: Pawmot
cards.description: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

cards.name: Tadbulb
cards.description: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

cards.name: Tadbulb
cards.description: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

cards.name: Wattrel
cards.description: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

cards.name: Wattrel
cards.description: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

cards.name: Kilowattrel
cards.description: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.description: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.description: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

cards.name: Mismagius
cards.description: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

cards.name: Spiritomb
cards.description: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.description: This Pokémon is normally very innocent. When it is staring at something invisible, it is unblinking and utterly silent.

cards.name: Gothorita
cards.description: This Pokémon will hypnotize children to put them to sleep before carrying them away. Be wary of nights when the starlight is bright.

cards.name: Gothitelle
cards.description: Gothitelle unleashes psychic energy and shows opponents dreams of the universe's end. These dreams are apparently ethereal and beautiful.

cards.name: Oranguru
cards.description: People used to mistake Oranguru for a human when they saw it issue command after command to the other Pokémon of the forest.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.description: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else— like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

cards.name: Palossand
cards.description: The terrifying Palossand drags smaller Pokémon into its sandy body. Once its victims are trapped, it drains them of their vitality whenever it pleases.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.description: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

cards.name: Ceruledge
cards.description: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

cards.name: Rabsca
cards.description: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

cards.name: Tinkatink
cards.description: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

cards.name: Tinkatink
cards.description: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

cards.name: Tinkatink
cards.description: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

cards.name: Tinkatuff
cards.description: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

cards.name: Tinkatuff
cards.description: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

cards.name: Tinkaton
cards.description: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.description: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.description: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

cards.name: Paldean Tauros
cards.description: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

cards.name: Sudowoodo
cards.description: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.description: Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.description: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.description: It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

cards.name: Hariyama
cards.description: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.description: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.description: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.description: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.description: This Pokémon battles by throwing hard berries. It won't obey a Trainer who throws Poké Balls without skill.

cards.name: Falinks
cards.description: The brass, which is the one that stands at the front and issues orders, is the strongest and smartest of the six.

cards.name: Nacli
cards.description: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

cards.name: Nacli
cards.description: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

cards.name: Naclstack
cards.description: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.

cards.name: Garganacl
cards.description: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

cards.name: Glimmet
cards.description: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

cards.name: Glimmet
cards.description: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.

cards.name: Glimmora
cards.description: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

cards.name: Paldean Wooper
cards.description: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

cards.name: Paldean Wooper
cards.description: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.description: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.description: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.description: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn't care about others.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.description: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

cards.name: Seviper
cards.description: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

cards.name: Deino
cards.description: It can't see, so its first approach to examining things is to bite them. You will be covered in wounds until a Deino warms up to you.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.description: The two heads do not get along at all. If you don't give each head the same amount of attention, they'll begin fighting out of jealousy.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.description: Only the central head has a brain. It is very intelligent, but it thinks only of destruction.

cards.name: Maschiff
cards.description: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

cards.name: Maschiff
cards.description: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff's face.

cards.name: Mabosstiff
cards.description: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.

cards.name: Shroodle
cards.description: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

cards.name: Shroodle
cards.description: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

cards.name: Grafaiai
cards.description: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

cards.name: Bombirdier
cards.description: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon's chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.

cards.name: Corviknight
cards.description: Corviknight can't serve as a taxi service in Paldea because the Pokémon's natural predators will attack it while it flies, endangering the customer.

cards.name: Cufant
cards.description: Using the pointy tip of its trunk, it carves off chunks of hard rocks to eat. It is very docile and helps people with physical labor.

cards.name: Orthworm
cards.description: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.description: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

cards.name: Girafarig
cards.description: Though very small, the brain in its tail is still considered an important organ because it emits powerful psychic energy.

cards.name: Farigiraf
cards.description: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.description: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

cards.name: Dudunsparce
cards.description: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

cards.name: Wingull
cards.description: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.description: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.description: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

cards.name: Vigoroth
cards.description: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

cards.name: Slaking
cards.description: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.description: This Pokémon is normally calm, but once it enters battle, its hormonal balance changes and it becomes aggressive.

cards.name: Rookidee
cards.description: This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white markings around a Rookidee's eyes intimidate fainthearted Pokémon.

cards.name: Corvisquire
cards.description: It's said that the reason behind Corvisquire's high level of intelligence is the large size of its brain relative to those of other bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Tandemaus
cards.description: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

cards.name: Tandemaus
cards.description: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

cards.name: Maushold
cards.description: They build huge nests with many rooms that are used for different purposes, such as eating and sleeping.

cards.name: Flamigo
cards.description: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.
